text:
Mike: Starting gentle evening shift for router cluster eu-west-1 -> plan: staggered 5% every 3 min, 5m quiet after each step. @Rachel can you verify canary pool warm?
DeployBot: Initiating rollout: router-service v3 -> v4; change window 2026-03-20 19:30 UTC; uid=rb-6201234567
Rachel: Canary pool looks warm, 3/3 pods ready. Latency p95 baseline 120ms.
Jordan: I'm watching logs, no errors so far. I'll keep an eye on p50/p95.
Mike: OK proceeding to step1: 5% traffic. Command:
```
rbctl weight-set --cluster eu-west-1 --service router --weights 'v3:95,v4:5'
```
Rachel: Done. Confirmed traffic split via metrics: v4 5.1% :thumbsup: 
DeployBot: Rollout step succeeded: step=1 ok; next in 3m
SRE OnCall: Noted. Setting alarm thresholds: p95 > 250ms alert.
Jordan: p95 bumped to 140 -> within expected. CPU on v4 slightly higher (62%).
Mike: Advance to step2 (10%). If p95 stays < 200ms proceed; else rollback.
Rachel: Weight set to v3:90,v4:10. Metrics show small error spike 0.4% 40s ago, tracing shows a small spike in batcher queue.
Jordan: Investigating batcher config on v4; leaning toward transient backpressure. Reducing max_batch_size on v4 to 32.
Mike: Hold for 2m while Jordan tweaks. Do not advance.
Jordan: Patch applied, restarted pods. Error rate dropping back to baseline.
Rachel: Error rate back to 0.05%. p95 150ms.
Mike: Good. Advance to 25%. Command: `rbctl weight-set --service router --weights 'v3:75,v4:25'`
DeployBot: Manual approval required to exceed 20%. Approver needed: @Mike
Mike: Approving.
DeployBot: Rollout step succeeded: step=3 (25%)
SRE OnCall: Monitoring for 15m steady-state.
Rachel: Noted. Starting perf slices: small prompt A/B (same prompt) to check output fidelity.
Jordan: No regressions found in model outputs. embeddings and generation checks okay.
Mike: Plan to finish to 100% over next 30m if no regressions. Release notes: minor routing change + batcher tweak; pinned v4 for canary. ops: annotate rollout ticket RB-6201.
Rachel: I'll post a brief note to #customer-success if we escalate to larger cohorts.
Mike: Thanks all. If anything odd, rollback command:
```
rbctl rollback --service router --to-version v3 --force
```
DeployBot: Rollout complete: final=25% (paused), awaiting manual continue. uid=rb-6201234567
Mike: Leaving paused at 25% for quiet window overnight. Will resume 2026-03-21 06:00 UTC.
Jordan: Logging done. I'll re-open if alarms fire. :eyes: 
Rachel: Locking change in changelog RB-6201 and tagging release v4-canary.
Mike: Great job. :party:
